rv.q: As someone who was largely unfamiliar with the real Buena Vista Social Club going in, I had a great time throughout.
The exuberant cast is hugely talented and bring this charming piece of musical history to life.
Every aspect of this musical speaks joy.
The whole experience here is a feast for the senses.
Everything about this musical — the story, the movement, the music, the look, the feel — talks to us in a way we understand because the very DNA of the "Buena Vista Social Club" is sooooo SoFlo.

cn.t: Critics praise the infectious Latin rhythms and sizzling energy, noting the Spanish-language music itself becomes the heart and soul of this jukebox musical about Cuban musicians from the 1950s to 1990s.
